title: Mobile Telecom Network Engineer
description:
Mobile Network Engineer (Mobile RAN Performance)

Hybrid | UK | Contract Opportunity

Duration: 6 months+

Rate: £500 per day (inside IR35)

Location: London or Bristol (Hybrid)


Are you an experienced Mobile Network Performance Engineer with a passion for optimising critical telecommunications infrastructure? We're working with a leading UK telecommunications organisation that is investing heavily in the performance and evolution of its mobile network estate and is seeking a specialist to support the delivery of high-profile network performance and optimisation initiatives.

This is an exciting opportunity to work on business-critical mobile network services, helping to maintain and enhance network performance, reliability, and customer experience across large-scale 4G and emerging 5G environments.


The Role

As a Network Engineering Specialist, you will be responsible for analysing network performance, identifying root causes of service degradation, and driving improvements across radio access network (RAN) environments. You'll work closely with internal stakeholders, project teams, equipment vendors, and third-party suppliers to deliver performance enhancements and support future network strategy.


Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct detailed performance investigations using UE logs, protocol traces, Wireshark analysis, and drive test data.
  • Perform root cause analysis on network issues and identify corrective actions to improve KPIs and customer experience.
  • Analyse LTE signalling, SIP traffic, and application-level performance across the network stack.
  • Review performance trends and support optimisation activities within large-scale mobile RAN environments.
  • Collaborate with engineering, delivery, and supplier teams to implement network improvements and resolve technical issues.
  • Support the definition of future network performance strategies and best practice guidelines.


Essential Skills & Experience

  • Extensive experience within mobile telecommunications network performance and optimisation.
  • Strong expertise in UE log analysis and troubleshooting tools such as Accuver, Nemo, TEMS, or similar.
  • Deep understanding of LTE networks, radio performance analysis, and optimisation techniques.
  • Experience analysing drive test logs, protocol traces, and Wireshark captures.
  • Strong knowledge of LTE signalling, SIP, and network troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Understanding of Nokia RAN environments.
  • Familiarity with KPI measurement, analysis, and optimisation.
  • Experience working with performance management, OSS, and network monitoring data.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Desirable Experience

  • Knowledge of public safety or mission-critical communications environments.
  • Experience with Ericsson RAN technologies.
  • Understanding of 3GPP and ETSI standards.
  • Knowledge of SRTP, DTLS, Push-to-Talk (PTT), and related mobile communications technologies.
  • Exposure to 5G network technologies and future network evolution programmes.


If you're a Mobile Network Performance SME with strong LTE optimisation and troubleshooting experience and are looking for your next contract opportunity, we'd love to hear from you.
